statBlock.name: Adult Brass Dragon
statBlock.description: This desert dragon favors conversation. Its lair hides mirages and refreshing water.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When it fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can replace one with either Sleep Breath or Scorching Ray through Spellcasting.
Rend. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Fire damage.
Fire Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. line that is 5 ft. wide makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 45 (10d8) Fire damage. Success halves the damage.
Sleep Breath. Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On failure, it is Incapacitated until the end of its next turn, when it repeats the save. On a second failure, it falls Unconscious for 10 minutes. Damage ends the unconsciousness, as does an action taken by a creature within 5 ft. to wake it.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells takes an action. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (save DC 16). The spells require no Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Minor Illusion, Scorching Ray, Shapechange, Speak with Animals.
1/day each. Detect Thoughts, Control Weather.
Shapechange is limited to Beast and Humanoid forms. It grants no Temporary Hit Points, and maintaining it requires neither Concentration nor Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Legendary actions:
It has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one use on one option immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn. It cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Blazing Light. Cast Scorching Ray through Spellcasting.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
Scorching Sands. One visible creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 16 Dexterity save. On failure, it takes 27 (6d8) Fire damage and its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn. The dragon must wait until the start of its next turn to choose this option again, regardless of the save result.
sections.Lair resources: The encounter is worth 11,500 XP in the lair. The dragon has 4 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.
sections.Regional effects:
Mirages. While in the lair, the dragon can cast Major Image using the same spellcasting ability as its Spellcasting action and without Material components. The range is 1 mile, and it does not need to see where the illusion appears.
Refreshing Water. Drinking water from within 1 mile of the lair grants 2d4 Temporary Hit Points. The dragon immediately learns that the drinker is present.
Both effects end immediately when the dragon dies or moves its lair.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 55 and 56 for the stat block and regional effects.

statBlock.name: Adult Bronze Dragon
statBlock.description: This coastal dragon breathes lightning. Around its lair, currents make swimming easier and the dragon can change the weather.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It can breathe both air and water.
Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When it fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can replace one with either Repulsion Breath or level 2 Guiding Bolt through Spellcasting.
Rend. Melee attack, +12 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 16 (2d8 + 7) Slashing damage plus 5 (1d10) Lightning damage.
Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. line that is 5 ft. wide makes a DC 19 Dexterity save. Failure deals 55 (10d10) Lightning damage. Success halves the damage.
Repulsion Breath. Each creature in a 30-ft. cone makes a DC 19 Strength save. Failure pushes it up to 60 ft. directly away from the dragon and knocks it Prone.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells takes an action. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (save DC 17, +10 to hit with spell attacks). The spells require no Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Guiding Bolt (level 2), Shapechange, Speak with Animals, Thaumaturgy.
1/day each. Detect Thoughts, Water Breathing.
Shapechange is limited to Beast and Humanoid forms. It grants no Temporary Hit Points, and maintaining it requires neither Concentration nor Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Legendary actions:
It has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one use on one option immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn. It cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Guiding Light. Cast level 2 Guiding Bolt through Spellcasting.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
Thunderclap. Center a 20-ft.-radius sphere on a visible point within 90 ft. Each creature inside makes a DC 17 Constitution save. On failure, it takes 10 (3d6) Thunder damage and is Deafened until the end of its next turn.
sections.Lair resources: The encounter is worth 15,000 XP in the lair. The dragon has 4 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.
sections.Regional effects:
Buoying Currents. Within 1 mile of the lair, swimming costs no extra movement for creatures without a Swim Speed.
Sun and Storms. While in the lair, the dragon can cast Control Weather using the same spellcasting ability as its Spellcasting action and without Material components. The spell affects weather out to 1 mile from the lair and works whether the dragon is indoors or outdoors.
Both effects end immediately when the dragon dies or moves its lair.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 59 and 60 for the stat block and regional effects.

statBlock.name: Adult Copper Dragon
statBlock.description: This playful dragon dwells among hills. Nearby animals learn Draconic, and intruders can break into fits of laughter.

sections.Traits: Legendary Resistance (3/day, or 4/day in its lair). When it fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can replace one with either Slowing Breath or level 4 Mind Spike through Spellcasting.
Rend. Melee attack, +11 to hit, reach 10 ft. Hit 17 (2d10 + 6) Slashing damage plus 4 (1d8) Acid damage.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 60-ft. line that is 5 ft. wide makes a DC 18 Dexterity save. Failure deals 54 (12d8) Acid damage. Success halves the damage.
Slowing Breath. Each creature in a 60-ft. cone makes a DC 18 Constitution save. On failure, its Speed is halved, it cannot take Reactions, and it must choose between taking an action and taking a Bonus Action on its turn. These effects last until the end of its next turn.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells takes an action. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (save DC 17). The spells require no Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Mind Spike (level 4), Minor Illusion, Shapechange.
1/day each. Greater Restoration, Major Image.
Shapechange is limited to Beast and Humanoid forms. It grants no Temporary Hit Points, and maintaining it requires neither Concentration nor Temporary Hit Points.
sections.Legendary actions:
It has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one use on one option immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn. It cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Giggling Magic. One visible creature within 90 ft. makes a DC 17 Charisma save. On failure, it takes 24 (7d6) Psychic damage. Until the end of its next turn, it rolls and subtracts 1d6 from each ability check or attack roll it makes. The dragon must wait until the start of its next turn to choose this option again, regardless of the save result.
Mind Jolt. Cast level 4 Mind Spike through Spellcasting. The dragon cannot choose this option again until the start of its next turn.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: The encounter is worth 13,000 XP in the lair. The dragon has 4 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.
sections.Regional effects:
Chatty Critters. Tiny Beasts within 6 miles of the lair can magically speak and understand Draconic.
Giggle Fits. When a creature other than the dragon or one of its allies rolls a natural 1 on a D20 Test within 1 mile of the lair, it makes a DC 15 Wisdom save. Failure leaves it Incapacitated with laughter until the end of its next turn.
Both effects end immediately when the dragon dies or moves its lair.
sections.Printed source: Monster Manual (2024), pp. 79 and 80 for the stat block and regional effects.

statBlock.name: Ancient Black Dragon
statBlock.description: This ancient dragon fouls the water around its swamp lair. Fog slows travelers as they approach.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. It can breathe both air and water.
Legendary Resistance (4/day, or 5/day in its lair). When it fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks. The dragon can replace one with level 4 Melf's Acid Arrow through Spellcasting.
Rend. Melee attack, +15 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit 17 (2d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 9 (2d8) Acid damage.
Acid Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. line that is 10 ft. wide makes a DC 22 Dexterity save. Failure deals 67 (15d8) Acid damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Spellcasting:
Casting one of these spells takes an action. Charisma is the spellcasting ability (save DC 21, +13 to hit with spell attacks). The spells require no Material components.
At will. Detect Magic, Fear, Melf's Acid Arrow (level 4).
1/day each. Create Undead, Speak with Dead, Vitriolic Sphere (level 5).
sections.Legendary actions:
It has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one use on one option immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn. It cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
Cloud of Insects. One visible creature within 120 ft. makes a DC 21 Dexterity save. On failure, it takes 33 (6d10) Poison damage and has Disadvantage on saves to maintain Concentration until the end of its next turn. The dragon must wait until the start of its next turn to choose this option again, regardless of the save result.
Frightful Presence. Cast Fear through Spellcasting. The dragon cannot choose this option again until the start of its next turn.
Pounce. Move up to half its Speed and make one Rend attack.
sections.Lair resources: The encounter is worth 41,000 XP in the lair. The dragon has 5 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.
sections.Regional effects:
Acrid Haze. Foul fog leaves the area within 1 mile of the lair Lightly Obscured. Travel there takes twice as long for creatures other than the dragon and its allies.
Foul Water. Water sources within 1 mile of the lair are magically polluted. A creature drinking that water makes a DC 15 Constitution save or becomes Poisoned for 1 hour.
Both effects end immediately when the dragon dies or moves its lair.

statBlock.name: Ancient Blue Dragon
statBlock.description: This dragon hunts amid dust and thunderstorms. Even the ground near its lair can give way beneath travelers.

Lightning Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 120-ft. line that is 10 ft. wide makes a DC 23 Dexterity save. Failure deals 88 (16d10) Lightning damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Spellcasting:

Cloaked Flight. Cast Invisibility on itself through Spellcasting and can fly up to half its Fly Speed. The dragon cannot choose this option again until the start of its next turn.

sections.Lair resources: The encounter is worth 62,000 XP in the lair. The dragon has 5 daily Legendary Resistance uses and 4 legendary action uses there.

statBlock.name: Ancient White Dragon
statBlock.speed: 40 ft., burrow 40 ft., fly 80 ft., swim 40 ft.
statBlock.description: This arctic dragon crosses ice effortlessly. Chilly fog and dangerously cold water surround its lair.

sections.Traits:
Ice Walk. It can cross and climb icy surfaces without an ability check. Difficult Terrain made of ice or snow costs it no extra movement.
Legendary Resistance (4/day, or 5/day in its lair). When it fails a save, it can spend a use to succeed instead.
sections.Actions:
Multiattack. Make three Rend attacks.
Rend. Melee attack, +14 to hit, reach 15 ft. Hit 17 (2d8 + 8) Slashing damage plus 7 (2d6) Cold damage.
Cold Breath (recharge 5–6). Each creature in a 90-ft. cone makes a DC 22 Constitution save. Failure deals 63 (14d8) Cold damage. Success halves the damage.
sections.Legendary actions:
It has 3 uses, or 4 in its lair. It can spend one use on one option immediately after another creature’s turn. It regains spent uses at the start of its turn. It cannot take legendary actions while Incapacitated or otherwise unable to act.
